results.question: How many employees are in each department?
results.sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(e.id) FROM departments AS d LEFT JOIN employees AS e ON d.id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: Which five products generated the highest revenue?
results.sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS rev FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Show monthly revenue for the previous six months.
results.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date) AS DATE) AS m, SUM(total_amount) AS rev FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY m ORDER BY m DESC LIMIT 6

results.question: Which customers have not placed an order?
results.sql: SELECT c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id IS NULL LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the average order value?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(total_amount) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS aov FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 500

results.question: Which department has the highest average salary?
results.sql: SELECT d.name, ROUND(CAST(AVG(e.salary) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_sal FROM departments AS d JOIN employees AS e ON d.id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY avg_sal DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Show the top ten customers by lifetime spending.
results.sql: SELECT c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS lifetime_spend FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY lifetime_spend DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: Compare monthly order counts.
results.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date) AS DATE) AS m, COUNT(id) AS order_cnt FROM orders GROUP BY m ORDER BY m DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: Which products have low sales?
results.sql: SELECT p.name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_sold FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_sold ASC LIMIT 5

results.question: Identify customers with declining purchase frequency.
results.sql: SELECT c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING MAX(o.order_date) < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '180 DAYS' LIMIT 500

results.question: List all active employees in Engineering.
results.sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, e.job_title, e.salary FROM employees AS e JOIN departments AS d ON d.id = e.department_id WHERE d.name = 'Engineering' AND e.is_active = TRUE LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the total annual payroll across all departments?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(salary) AS total_payroll FROM employees WHERE is_active = TRUE LIMIT 500

results.question: List departments where budget exceeds one million dollars.
results.sql: SELECT name, budget FROM departments WHERE budget > 1000000 ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: Find the highest paid employee in each department.
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (department_id) d.name, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.salary FROM employees AS e JOIN departments AS d ON d.id = e.department_id ORDER BY department_id, salary DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: How many inactive employees are currently recorded?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE is_active = FALSE LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the average salary in the Sales department?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(e.salary) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM employees AS e JOIN departments AS d ON d.id = e.department_id WHERE d.name = 'Sales' LIMIT 500

results.question: List employees hired after January 1st, 2023.
results.sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, hire_date FROM employees WHERE hire_date >= '2023-01-01' ORDER BY hire_date ASC LIMIT 500

results.question: Count employees grouped by job title.
results.sql: SELECT job_title, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM employees GROUP BY job_title ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: Which department has the lowest operational budget?
results.sql: SELECT name, budget FROM departments ORDER BY budget ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: Find all employees with a salary greater than 150000.
results.sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, salary, job_title FROM employees WHERE salary > 150000 ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: List all products in the Software category.
results.sql: SELECT name, price, cost FROM products WHERE category = 'Software' ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the total inventory valuation at cost?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost * stock_quantity), 2) AS inventory_value FROM products LIMIT 500

results.question: Which products have fewer than 30 items in stock?
results.sql: SELECT name, category, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 30 ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC LIMIT 500

results.question: Calculate profit margin for each product category.
results.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(CAST(AVG((price - cost) / price * 100) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_margin_pct FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY avg_margin_pct DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: Find the single most expensive product in catalog.
results.sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Count total products per category.
results.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: List products priced between 100 and 500 dollars.
results.sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 100 AND 500 ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 500

results.question: Which product generated the most units sold?
results.sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_units DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: List accessories with price greater than 100.
results.sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Accessories' AND price > 100 LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the average product sales price by category?
results.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(CAST(AVG(price) AS DECIMAL), 2) FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: Count customers by loyalty tier.
results.sql: SELECT tier, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY tier ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: List all Platinum tier customers.
results.sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, email, city, country FROM customers WHERE tier = 'Platinum' LIMIT 500

results.question: How many customers are located in Germany?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany' LIMIT 500

results.question: List top five cities with the most customers.
results.sql: SELECT city, country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY city, country ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Which customers have active SaaS subscriptions?
results.sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, s.plan_name, s.monthly_price FROM subscriptions AS s JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE s.status = 'active' LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the Monthly Recurring Revenue from active subscriptions?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(monthly_price) AS mrr FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' LIMIT 500

results.question: Count subscriptions grouped by plan name.
results.sql: SELECT plan_name, COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions GROUP BY plan_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: Find customers who have cancelled their subscription.
results.sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, s.plan_name, s.end_date FROM subscriptions AS s JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE s.status = 'cancelled' LIMIT 500

results.question: Count total registered customers by country.
results.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS cust_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY cust_count DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: List customers with an Enterprise subscription.
results.sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email FROM subscriptions AS s JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE s.plan_name = 'Enterprise' LIMIT 500

results.question: Count total orders by order status.
results.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the total value of completed orders?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS completed_rev FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 500

results.question: How many orders were cancelled?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' LIMIT 500

results.question: What payment method is used most frequently?
results.sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'success' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY txn_count DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Calculate total payments settled through credit card.
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE payment_method = 'credit_card' AND payment_status = 'success' LIMIT 500

results.question: List orders with total amount greater than 2000.
results.sql: SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 2000 ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 500

results.question: Which shipping cities received the most orders?
results.sql: SELECT shipping_city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY shipping_city ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Count orders placed in the last 30 days.
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 DAYS' LIMIT 500

results.question: What is the total refunded amount across payments?
results.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_refunded FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'refunded' LIMIT 500

results.question: Show distribution of order quantities per item.
results.sql: SELECT quantity, COUNT(*) AS count_items FROM order_items GROUP BY quantity ORDER BY quantity ASC LIMIT 500
